lines.en: The difference score returned 3 when it exited early.
And 3 fell inside the too-similar range.

lines.ko: 임시 점수를 범위 밖 큰 수로 바꿨습니다.
lines.en: I moved the placeholder outside that range.
Everyone gets the same 10 questions each day.

lines.ko: 정답은 서버만 알아서 미리 볼 수 없습니다.
lines.en: Answers live only on the server, so no peeking.
The complex data in the questions is still sample material.
